assumptions.claim: prd_masking must have a total width of at least 4*WidthPRDRow to support the part-select indexes used in the loop.
assumptions.cond: when this generate block is synthesized/used
assumptions.risk: If prd_masking is narrower, part-select range is out-of-bounds, leading to undefined behaviour or X propagation.
